end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles, quadrilaterals, and pentagons.
Named shapes from their sides and corners in different positions.
Identified that slanted or rotated triangles remain triangles.
Teach-back was not passed; one side-counting response was unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting straight sides and corners, then naming shapes even when they were tilted or turned. Ayaan explained that a triangle still has three sides and three corners when its position changes, and later confirmed this clearly. They briefly mixed up the number of triangle corners, but later corrected it by stating that a triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners. At home, ask Ayaan to find a few shapes around the house and count their sides and corners aloud.
